evidence.title: Zoah: the future of software development
Canvas: design real code components | Zoah

name: Zoah
summary: Visual-first development platform that designs, builds and deploys software with AI agents on one canvas.
description: An early-access full-stack platform for designing and shipping software visually (previously Opacity). Products are designed on a DOM-based canvas where the design is production code, edited with a vector editor, worked on together with teammates and AI agents through git-like branching and reviews, and deployed in one click; components can be published as npm packages. A macOS app, a CLI and an MCP server are offered, and pricing centres on a Business plan (50% off the first year for Founding Members).
contains: visual canvas where designs are production code
AI agents (Operators) that work continuously without prompts
vector editor with constraints and smart pen tool
real-time collaboration with git-like branching and reviews
publish real code components as npm packages
early access: Founding Member offer, 50% off the Business plan first year
